sources.quote_checked: there's not a liberal America and a conservative America - there's the United States of America | The audacity of hope!

sources.title: Farewell Address
sources.quote_checked: democracy does require a basic sense of solidarity | It needs you. Not just when there's an election. | Show up. Dive in. Stay at it. | I'm asking you to believe. Not in my ability to bring about change -- but in yours.

sources.title: Remarks by the President at Howard University Commencement Ceremony
sources.quote_checked: change requires more than righteous anger. It requires a program, and it requires organizing. | democracy requires compromise, even when you are 100 percent right. | better is good, because you consolidate your gains and then you move on to the next fight from a stronger position. | I will take better every time. | change requires more than just speaking out -- it requires listening, as well. | you will feel good about yourself, you will enjoy a certain moral purity, but you're not going to get what you want. | let them talk
